description: This file defines functions and constants for provider discovery, including loading runtime modules, resolving provider catalogs, grouping providers by order, normalizing discovery results, and running provider catalog operations.

methods.name: loadProviderRuntime
methods.description: Loads the provider discovery runtime module asynchronously, caching the promise.

methods.name: resolveProviderCatalogHook
methods.description: Resolves the catalog or discovery property of a provider plugin.

methods.name: resolvePluginDiscoveryProviders
methods.description: Resolves and filters plugin discovery providers based on runtime resolution.

methods.name: groupPluginDiscoveryProvidersByOrder
methods.description: Groups a list of providers by their discovery order and sorts them by label.

methods.name: normalizePluginDiscoveryResult
methods.description: Normalizes the discovery result into a record keyed by normalized provider IDs.

methods.name: runProviderCatalog
methods.description: Executes the run method of a provider's catalog, passing configuration and environment parameters.
